local_api.description: This adds the device to HA using the local HTTP API. Only notifications are supported. Use MQTT or HA API for full functionality.

ha_api_info.title: Connect over the HA API
ha_api_info.description:
Make sure HASS.Agent .NET10 is running on the PC and set to use the **HA API** connection.

Then open the app, go to **Danger Zone** and press **Republish discovery** — or simply restart the app.

Press **Submit** here once you have done that, and the PC will be added.
